historical_scope_notes: The frozen scope retains its pre-review remaining-gate wording as historical text. This root review records the prompt and protocol review gates as satisfied; it does not change that scope or authorize execution.
limitations: Analyst source controls and saved-evidence replays are not new model-generated growth.
Vest additions are specification/proof-library growth, not executable parser generation.
Direct child implementations remain valid; observed API reuse is separate from whole-scope proof success and necessary proof dependence.
Two development chains do not establish causal sharing/depth effects, held-out generalization or language superiority.

native_evidence.independent_vest_review: All twelve actual saved outcomes, complete native success flags and multiplicities, source/registration boundaries and resources were reviewed by a separate read-only agent. Original raw archives remain published in controls-001.

pilot_review.budget_rule: One independent response per stage; no retries or reassignment. Failed parents block their children. Ambiguous provider/integrity/unresolved native execution stops future dispatch.
pilot_review.context: Seventeen complete pinned upstream files with licenses; explicitly not full dependency closure. Native verification retains the full qualified declared scope.
pilot_review.model_provenance_dependency: Stage two is deferred until a trusted host supplies exact same-lineage stage-one model/request/source/native acceptance. No reference fallback or synthetic live payload.
pilot_review.root_and_independent_prompt_review: The final four payloads match approved preview-003 byte for byte. Root and an independent read-only agent checked context selection, exact target contracts/types/imports, language-specific syntax, grammar bounds, source visibility and absence of new reference solutions or analyst advice.
pilot_review.view_transform: Only five allowlisted leading metadata comment lines are removed for display across four templates; candidate source stays exact. The same display rule preserves an actual accepted parent body.

protocol_review.origin_boundary: Known analyst whole-observation fingerprints and explicit synthetic fixtures are ineligible by default. An independently generated body may equal a reference, but the trusted future host must establish request provenance and a fresh native execution. Hash-consistent JSON alone is not authenticity.
protocol_review.root_code_review: Reviewed source reconstruction, exact control loading, actual stage-one scopes, native bindings, provenance exclusions, receipt matching and the public parent-validator path. The copied v2 public validator was found during review and changed to forward to the v3 validator; final regression and full focused suite passed. All intermediate logs remain preserved.

remaining_execution_gates: Implement and review a bounded live host that establishes model/request provenance, guarded source lineage and fresh native evidence before issuing acceptance
Review one-CPU verification settings and exclusive staging/submission with no retries and canonical request accounting
Obtain separate explicit user approval for a new concrete paid scope and private credential handoff only when execution is ready
satisfied_preparation_gates: Source-bound native reference and negative controls
Offline protected-body and actual-parent integration review
Exact first-stage prompts, deferred-child rendering rule, settings and eight-slot proposal frozen
